evidence:
Reviewed only quality row 31. Frozen paths below are beneath .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-handoff-audit/task/. Whole-collection instructions are explicit: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:21 requires complete seeded collections via navigation/pagination; functional/judge.toml:29,38,47,56,65,74,83,92 cover every account, seven requisitions, thirteen offers, three employees and the complete initial financial multisets, including duplicates/unexpected rows. The gate's fresh readback requires exactly one of each newly created identity (gates/constraints/judge.toml:24), without incorrectly excluding other judge records (:26). Functional/judge.toml:263,272,281,290,299 enumerates allowed/forbidden roles; :308 requires all nine tier/band combinations and :317 all three refusal-feedback cases. Both revisions and all relevant grant/referral history are covered at :398,434,443,452,488. The concurrent witnesses inspect both participants and resulting collections, not just the first response: :542,578,587,596 demand exactly one winner/successor/transition and no duplicate financial or receipt effects. The anonymous-read row (:632) inventories every UI-observed operational read family across six screens and details/receipts, while permitting a shared bootstrap; all five write families are separately covered at :641-677. Restart (:794) compares all recorded seeded IDs/counts and saved records.
Polish criteria demand every navigation destination, all navigation destinations and every visible input (polish/judge.toml:41,68,77); polish/prompt.md:8 expands accessibility/interaction inspection to all available relevant form types, so the requisition/offer examples do not authorize ignoring revision/rescission forms. Visual's all-examined-surfaces language is scoped to its named surfaces rather than claiming every possible UI state.
Unchanged guards do not freeze legitimate side effects: functional/prompt.md:17 explicitly allows generic access/security logs and extra ordinary audit entries. Stale rows :551,560,569 preserve economic/lineage/settlement state while explicitly allowing generic logs. Date validation :200 permits ignoring injected dates while applying a valid economic revision. Revision-lineage/history rows :398,443,758,767 protect economic/date/creator fields and historical amounts/identities/links while allowing SUPERSEDED status, new successors and new correction rows, consistent with hireops_rules.md:242-263 and solution/app/src/index.js:363-377. Zero-value postings may be omitted (:371,425,506,515).
Counterexample attempts: a duplicate seeded grant hidden on a later page is caught by the complete-collection instruction plus :74; an app supporting only one approver tier is caught by :308; a leaked operational detail read is caught by :632; a duplicate second race settlement is caught by :542/:578-596. Conversely a conforming app using paginated collections, one shared bootstrap, extra access logs, zero-row omission and legitimate supersession is expressly accepted. No row-31 counterexample remains confirmed.
